iRobot Roomba i7+ replacement parts.

Choose a replacement filter, roller brush kit, side brush or Clean Base bag for the iRobot Roomba i7+. Parts for the robot and bags for its self-emptying dock are listed separately.

Check the variant: This guide covers the vacuum-only Roomba i7+ with Clean Base. A standard Roomba i7 may use the same robot consumables, but it does not need a Clean Base bag unless you have that dock. The Combo j7+ and Combo j9+ are different models; iRobot excludes them from its standard e/i/j refill kit.

iRobot Roomba i7+ replacement filters

Three genuine iRobot 4639161 high-efficiency filters.

View replacement filters on Amazon ↗

Fit: iRobot lists this e/i/j-series filter for Roomba i-series vacuums, including the i7+.

Replace when: iRobot recommends replacing the i-series filter every 2 months, or sooner if it is damaged or airflow stays restricted after cleaning.

Before buying: This filter is not washable. Tap debris off and keep it dry. This listing does not establish compatibility with Combo j7+ or Combo j9+.

iRobot Roomba i7+ replacement roller brushes

Genuine iRobot kit with one set of dual multi-surface rubber brushes, three filters and three edge-sweeping brushes.

View roller brush refill kit on Amazon ↗

Fit: iRobot's e/i/j refill kit includes the Roomba i7+. The robot uses a matched pair of dual rubber brushes.

Replace when: iRobot recommends replacing the dual multi-surface brushes every 6–12 months. Clean wrapped hair and debris weekly, or twice weekly in homes with pets.

Before buying: This is a multi-part kit, not a roller-only pack. iRobot excludes Combo j7+ and Combo j9+ from this standard refill kit; confirm the selected Amazon pack contents before ordering.

iRobot Roomba i7+ replacement side brushes

Three genuine iRobot 4757625 edge-sweeping brushes.

View side brushes on Amazon ↗

Fit: iRobot lists part 4757625 for Roomba i-series robots, including the i7+.

Replace when: Clean the edge-sweeping brush monthly. Replace it if the bristles or hub are bent, missing or damaged; iRobot does not give a fixed replacement interval.

Before buying: This is the small screw-mounted brush that sweeps along edges, not either of the two main rubber rollers. Check that the mounting screw is included in the selected pack.

EXACT-MODEL FIT

What is shared, and what needs checking?

Roomba i7 and i7+
The i7 and i7+ share i-series robot consumables covered by iRobot's e/i/j refill kit. The plus package includes a Clean Base; only buy dock bags if your setup has that base.
Robot parts vs. Clean Base bags
Filters, dual rubber brushes and edge-sweeping brushes install on the robot. Dirt-disposal bags install in the Clean Base dock. A matching bag does not establish fit for any robot part.
Roomba Combo models
Combo j7+ and Combo j9+ are separate vacuum-and-mop robots. iRobot explicitly excludes them from its standard e/i/j refill kit; do not infer compatibility from shared series wording or a shared dock bag.
Genuine parts
The four linked consumable listings are iRobot-branded parts. The refill-kit listing bundles rollers, filters and side brushes; the other cards provide individual filter, side-brush and Clean Base bag options.
CLEAN FIRST, REPLACE WHEN NEEDED

iRobot Roomba i7+ maintenance intervals

The manufacturer’s published care guidance for this model gives these intervals. Wear and your cleaning routine can change when a part needs replacement; follow the replacement manufacturer’s care instructions too.

iRobot Roomba i7+ cleaning and replacement intervals
PartCleanReplace
High-efficiency filterWeekly; twice weekly in homes with petsEvery 2 months
Dual multi-surface rubber brushesWeekly; twice weekly in homes with petsEvery 6–12 months
Edge-sweeping brushMonthlyNo fixed interval; replace when worn or damaged
Clean Base bagDisposable; keep the dock evacuation path clearWhen prompted by the base or app

Roomba e/i/j filters are not washable: tap off debris and keep them dry. Before replacing the dual rubber brushes, remove wrapped hair from the rollers and their end caps. If the Clean Base signals a bag problem, check that the bag is present and seated correctly before replacing it.

Before you order

Do Roomba i7 and i7+ use the same replacement parts?

The robot consumables in iRobot's e/i/j refill kit cover i-series models including i7+. The i7+ package also includes a Clean Base, so it uses a disposable dock bag; a standard i7 only needs one if you bought that dock separately.

Will this Roomba i7+ kit fit Combo j7+ or Combo j9+?

No. iRobot explicitly says its standard e/i/j replenishment kit is not compatible with Combo j7+ or Combo j9+. Use a Combo-specific listing and verify each item rather than relying on the shared j-series name.

How often should I replace Roomba i7+ filters and brushes?

iRobot recommends replacing the filter every 2 months and the dual rubber brushes every 6–12 months. Clean the filter weekly and the brushes weekly, or twice weekly in a home with pets. Clean the edge brush monthly and replace it when worn or damaged.

Are these genuine iRobot replacement parts?

Yes. The filter, roller-brush refill kit, side brushes and Clean Base bags are iRobot-branded listings. Compare the part number and selected pack on Amazon before ordering because listing details and variations can change.

Is the original Roomba i7+ robot listing available?

The exact Amazon listing shown here was marked unavailable when checked on October 7, 2026. Amazon availability can change, so confirm the model and Clean Base configuration on the live listing or a current replacement listing.
